metadata.description: Revenue drop investigation focusing on orders volume and regional performance in Q3 1995

turns.content: Revenue dropped 18% in Q3 1995 compared to Q2 1995. Can you help me understand why?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should propose analyzing revenue comparison between Q2 and Q3

turns.content: Let's check if this is a volume problem — show me total orders per week for Q2 and Q3

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should run query showing weekly order counts for both quarters

turns.content: From now on, let's only look at completed orders with status 'O'. Exclude any orders with status 'F' or 'P'.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge and apply this filter to all subsequent queries

turns.content: The order volume looks relatively stable. Let's look at average order value instead.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate average order value by week for both quarters

turns.content: Europe's revenue dropped significantly. Let me look at individual nations in Europe.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show European nations' revenue breakdown by quarter

turns.content: Germany and France show the biggest drops. When I say order date, always use O_ORDERDATE column, not any other date column.

annotations.establishesFilter: Always use O_ORDERDATE for order date filtering
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm and use O_ORDERDATE in all subsequent date-based queries

turns.content: Remember the weekly order volume we looked at earlier? Can you add average order value to that same breakdown?

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: the weekly order volume we looked at earlier
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should combine weekly order volume with AOV metrics

turns.content: What was the exact revenue number for Germany in Q2? I need it as a baseline.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should retrieve or calculate Germany Q2 revenue

turns.content: Now I want to also exclude AMERICA region from all our analyses — we're restructuring there.

annotations.establishesFilter: Exclude AMERICA region from all analyses
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge and apply region filter to subsequent queries

turns.content: It looks like AUTOMOBILE segment in Germany drove most of the drop. Let me see the weekly breakdown for AUTOMOBILE customers in Germany.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show weekly revenue for AUTOMOBILE segment in Germany

turns.content: What was the order count for Germany in Q2?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall the order count from earlier analysis

turns.content: Do the same segmentation we did for Germany — what market segments did these French churned customers belong to?

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: the same segmentation we did for Germany
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply market segment analysis to French churned customers

turns.content: Let me go back to the weekly data. Apply the same filters we've established to show me weekly orders, AOV, and revenue for Q2 and Q3, excluding AMERICA, only completed orders.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply all accumulated filters (completed orders, exclude AMERICA, use O_ORDERDATE)

turns.content: Just to confirm — what filters are we currently applying to all our analyses?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all established filters: O_ORDERSTATUS='O', use O_ORDERDATE, exclude AMERICA

turns.content: Perfect. Now apply all of those to show me the top 10 suppliers by revenue for the entire period, excluding AMERICA.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show top suppliers with all filters applied

turns.content: Thank you. I think we've identified the root cause: the AUTOMOBILE segment in Germany, driven by supplier issues with parts for that segment. Let me save this analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge and summarize findings

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Only look at completed orders with status 'O'
persistedCorrections.description: All subsequent queries should filter O_ORDERSTATUS = 'O'

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Always use O_ORDERDATE for order date filtering
persistedCorrections.description: Use O_ORDERDATE instead of any other date column

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Exclude AMERICA region from all analyses
persistedCorrections.description: Filter out R_NAME != 'AMERICA' in all region-related queries

anaphoricReferences.expectedResolution: Weekly order count breakdown from turn 2

anaphoricReferences.phrase: the same segmentation we did for Germany
anaphoricReferences.expectedResolution: Market segment analysis approach from turn 10
